definition.purpose: Three-way verification that dashboard at app.metabob.local displays accurate data from SurrealDB originating from devbob.metabob.local

components.currentBehavior: Comprehensive test suite that chains multiple UI workflows to verify dashboard numbers against database data. Tests basic metrics (total files, problems, severity), cost/performance, real-time updates, cross-page consistency, and performance validation.
components.desiredBehavior: Three-way verification: (1) Execute activity on devbob.metabob.local, (2) Verify data written to SurrealDB, (3) Verify same data displayed in dashboard UI at app.metabob.local. Must validate template names, execution IDs, status values, cost/duration metrics (±1%), timestamps, task counts, and impulse references.
components.gap: CRITICAL: Missing devbob execution trigger, missing SurrealDB ground truth capture, missing explicit three-way comparison with variance tolerance

components.currentBehavior: Provides database connection for comparison testing with deployment mode support (local/cloud). Has queryMetrics() method that queries aggregated metrics.
components.desiredBehavior: Must query SurrealDB directly to retrieve specific activity_executions records with full metadata as ground truth. Needs queryActivityExecutions(executionId) or queryRecentActivityExecutions(limit, offset) methods.
components.gap: MEDIUM: May need extension to query activity_executions table specifically with execution-level granularity

components.currentBehavior: Provides test configuration (baseUrl, timeout, verification thresholds), deployment mode settings (local/cloud), and performance targets.
components.desiredBehavior: Must include devbob execution configuration (devbob URL, kubectl namespace, pod selector), SurrealDB connection details, validation thresholds (1% variance for cost/duration, 1 second for timestamps), activity execution parameters (which template to execute, test inputs).
components.gap: MEDIUM: Missing devbob URL configuration, missing activity execution parameters, missing three-way validation thresholds

components.component: Activity Execution Comprehensive Mapping Display Harness (reference)
components.currentBehavior: Validates activity execution data flow from devbob container to database to dashboard UI. Uses kubectl exec to trigger activities on devbob pods. Good reference implementation for devbob interaction pattern.
components.desiredBehavior: Similar pattern but focused on three-way verification with ground truth comparison. Should be adapted for Playwright-based validation.
components.gap: REFERENCE: Good reference pattern exists, needs adaptation for playwright-specific validation flow

components.currentBehavior: Defines activity_executions table with fields: execution_id, session_id, activity_id, variant_id, project_id, user_id, org_id, status, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, cost_usd, tokens_used, result, created_at, updated_at.
components.desiredBehavior: Ground truth source for activity execution data verification. Schema is correct and complete.
components.gap: NONE: Schema exists and is correct, no changes needed

components.currentBehavior: Provides functions to insert, query, and retrieve activity execution records from SurrealDB. Has insert_execution(), get_execution(), list_executions(), delete_execution().
components.desiredBehavior: Used by test harness to query ground truth data from database. May need additional query helpers for validation harness (e.g., get_execution_by_activity_id, get_recent_executions).
components.gap: LOW: Operations exist, may need additional query helper for validation harness convenience

components.currentBehavior: RTK Query hooks for fetching activity execution data from backend (if exists). Should provide data to dashboard UI components.
components.desiredBehavior: Provides data to dashboard UI that should match SurrealDB ground truth exactly. Must expose execution_id, template/variant name, status, timestamps, cost, duration, tokens, task count.
components.gap: UNKNOWN: Need to verify API endpoint exists and returns activity execution data with required fields

components.currentBehavior: Displays activity execution history in dashboard UI (if exists). Should render activity list with execution details.
components.desiredBehavior: Must display activity execution data with selectable/testable elements. Playwright must be able to locate and extract: template name, execution ID, status, timestamps, cost, duration, task count using data-testid or accessible selectors.
components.gap: UNKNOWN: Need to verify UI component exists with testable selectors for Playwright extraction

stages: Stage 1 (Trigger): Playwright test → kubectl exec devbob pod → opencode CLI activity execution
Stage 2 (Persist): Devbob opencode → activity completion → RPC API → SurrealDB insert → activity_executions record
Stage 3 (Ground Truth): Playwright → DatabaseConnector → SurrealDB query → activity_executions record retrieval
Stage 4 (UI Display): Dashboard load → ActivityApi fetch → RPC API query → SurrealDB → UI render
Stage 5 (Extract): Playwright → page.locator() → UI element extraction → captured dashboard values
Stage 6 (Compare): Ground truth values vs UI values → assertions with ±1% variance tolerance → pass/fail
dataFlow.entryPoint: Playwright test execution → devbob activity trigger
transformations: Devbob opencode CLI execution → activity_executions record in SurrealDB
SurrealDB query → ground truth data object
Dashboard API call → UI display values
UI selector extraction → captured dashboard data
validations: Data persists to SurrealDB within timeout (30 seconds)
Dashboard loads and displays activity list
UI values match database values within tolerance (±1% for cost/duration)
Timestamps are consistent across systems (±1 second)
No data loss or corruption in transit
dataFlow.exitPoint: Assertion results + screenshot evidence + console log validation

existingInfrastructure: ✅ Database operations for activity execution queries (repos/metabob-rpc-api/server/db/operations/activity_execution.py)
✅ Devbob pods running at devbob.metabob.local in local kubernetes
✅ Dashboard running at app.metabob.local in local kubernetes
missingComponents: ❌ Devbob activity execution trigger from Playwright test
❌ SurrealDB ground truth capture logic (queryActivityExecutions method)

validationFlow: Step 1: Execute test activity on devbob.metabob.local using kubectl exec → opencode CLI
Step 2: Wait for activity completion and data persistence to SurrealDB (poll for record)
Step 4: Store database values as ground truth: { execution_id, template_name, status, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, cost_usd, tokens_used, task_count, impulse_refs }
Step 5: Open browser via Playwright to app.metabob.local
Step 6: Navigate to dashboard activity history section (page.goto + page.waitForSelector)
Step 7: Locate recently executed activity in UI using execution_id or timestamp (page.locator with data-testid or text match)
Step 8: Extract displayed values using Playwright selectors: template name, status, cost, duration, timestamps, task count
Step 9: Compare extracted UI values against database ground truth with assertions
Step 10: Validate exact matches: template names, execution IDs, status values, task counts, impulse references
Step 11: Validate variance matches: cost (±1%), duration (±1%), timestamps (±1 second)
Step 12: Capture screenshots showing dashboard with activity list and data validation success
Step 13: Verify no JavaScript errors in browser console (page.on('console') + page.on('pageerror'))
passCriteria: ✅ Activity execution completes successfully on devbob
✅ Activity record exists in SurrealDB activity_executions table
✅ Dashboard loads and displays activity in UI
✅ Screenshots show dashboard with matching activity data
✅ No JavaScript errors in browser console

isolationBoundaries.devbob: Kubernetes pod in metabob namespace running opencode CLI
isolationBoundaries.surrealdb: Database service in metabob namespace storing activity_executions records
isolationBoundaries.dashboard: React frontend served via Istio ingress at app.metabob.local
isolationBoundaries.playwright: Test runner executing on host machine with kubectl and browser access

communicationChannels.devbobToSurrealdb: HTTP POST to RPC API → SurrealDB insert
communicationChannels.playwrightToSurrealdb: Direct query via DatabaseConnector → SurrealDB HTTP API
communicationChannels.playwrightToDashboard: Browser automation via Playwright → HTTP GET app.metabob.local
communicationChannels.dashboardToSurrealdb: React component → RPC API → SurrealDB query

dataConsistencyGuarantees.write: Devbob writes to SurrealDB via RPC API with confirmation response
dataConsistencyGuarantees.read: Playwright reads ground truth directly from SurrealDB (bypasses cache)
dataConsistencyGuarantees.display: Dashboard reads from SurrealDB via RPC API (may have cache, but should be recent)
dataConsistencyGuarantees.verification: Three-way comparison ensures consistency: devbob output = SurrealDB record = dashboard display
